title: Acropolis: Hakon against Heron
lede: The first battles for the Runeforge Directorate and the Panhellenic League: Hakon the High Jarl's corporaiders and Einherjar against Heron of Alexandria's hoplites and machines, on the Acropolis. The closest of six: the League led 18 to 14 after three rounds, then Odin's Einherjar killed Heron and his bodyguard in a single fight, and the Directorate held every objective in Round 5 to win 32 to 28. Hakon's Army won 5 of the 6 battles, 29.2 VP to 20.3 on average, and lost 35.5 RP a battle to the League's 85.8.
result_line: Hakon's Army wins on Victory Points, 32 to 28
deployment:
Hakon's Army lines the south edge: Hakon leading Corporaider Squad 1 (3,12), Odin's Einherjar (4,12) and the Berserkir (5,12) on the left, Corporaider Squad 2 (9,12) and the Runesmith (10,12) on the right. It fights with The Gilded Ledger. Heron's Army takes the north: the Argyraspides (3,2) and League Hoplite 2 (5,2) on the left, the Asklepian Medic (9,2) and the Heliostat Battery (9,1) in the middle, Heron leading League Hoplite 1 (11,2) and the Hephaestian Tripod (11,1) on the right. It fights with the Apollonian Strike Force. The AI picked both doctrines.

The Acropolis has three objectives across the middle row: the centre (7,7) for 3 VP, the west (1,7) and the east (13,7) for 2. Hakon's Army has Priority.

1.title: The flanks and the centre split

feed.text: The League casts its Omen Dice (Delphic Apotropaia). Both sides spend Double Time and neither buys a move it could not have made. Missions: IRON CURTAIN for the Directorate, FORWARD PRESENCE for the League.

Hakon, Corporaider Squad 1 and the Einherjar take the west objective; the Runesmith runs to the east one (12,7). Heron and League Hoplite 1 take the centre (8,6); the Argyraspides come down the west edge (0,6) and the Asklepian Medic toward the east (10,7).
Nothing is in reach.
The Directorate holds the flanks, the League the centre. Hakon's Army 4, Heron's Army 3.

2.title: Rune of Thor, and a Runesmith lost

feed.text: Hostile Takeover on the Runesmith (+1 loot for each kill); the record cannot price a loot, so it shows as buying nothing. Missions: MAN OF THE HOUR for the Directorate, TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY for the League.

The Asklepian Medic charges the Runesmith on the east objective. The Runesmith breaks away in disorder and is shot dead by League Hoplite 1's Overwatch. The Berserkir charge League Hoplite 2; Hakon's squad pulls back to the west edge (0,8).
The Berserkir take 6 HP off League Hoplite 2 for 2. Hakon reads the Rune of Thor over the Argyraspides: 6 HP, -1 MS and BS, and PARALYZED.

The Directorate completes IRON CURTAIN and holds the west; the League holds the centre and the east, scores STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION and completes TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY. Heron's Army 14, Hakon's Army 8.
A Scouting Order lets the Berserkir spot the Hephaestian Tripod, which nothing else saw. Missions: STRONGPOINT for the Directorate, KING OF THE HILL for the League.

The Einherjar, the Berserkir and Corporaider Squad 2 all charge into the centre. League Hoplite 2 is destroyed breaking away in disorder; Heron and League Hoplite 1 pull back off the objective to (8,5).
The Argyraspides shoot 2 HP off the Berserkir, who use Alchemical Overdrive and lose a model when Feel No Pain fails.
The Directorate holds the centre and the west and completes STRONGPOINT; the League holds the east and scores its Primary. Heron's Army 18, Hakon's Army 14.
A Scouting Order lets the Argyraspides spot the Einherjar. Missions: COORDINATED PUSH for the Directorate, IRON CURTAIN for the League.
Odin's Einherjar charge Heron of Alexandria and League Hoplite 1 (8,6).

The Einherjar destroy Heron and his bodyguard in one fight: MAN OF THE HOUR (+4). The Heliostat Battery takes 4 HP off the Einherjar and the Tripod 2; the Argyraspides put 4 into Corporaider Squad 1, which goes to ground.
The Directorate holds the centre and the west; the League the east and its Primary. Hakon's Army 23, Heron's Army 23.
The Directorate requisitions a fresh Corporaider Squad; Double Time on Corporaider Squad 2 buys nothing.
The Einherjar charge onto the east objective (13,8); Corporaider Squad 2 charges the Hephaestian Tripod in the centre. The new squad comes up behind (12,8).

The Argyraspides destroy Corporaider Squad 1 on the west objective (KING OF THE HILL, +3). Corporaider Squad 2 destroys the Tripod. The Asklepian Medic attacks the Einherjar and is destroyed. The Heliostat Battery's Blinding Flash on Corporaider Squad 2 changes nothing.
The Directorate holds all three objectives and completes COORDINATED PUSH (+9); the League scores its Primary. Hakon's Army 32, Heron's Army 28.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.html:
The Directorate wins, and keeps its units

Hakon's Army won 5 of the 6 battles, on average 29.2 VP to 20.3. It dealt more damage (41.0 a battle against 28.0) and lost far less: 35.5 RP a battle against the League's 85.8. The gap shows in objectives (18.3 to 11.5) and secondaries (7.2 to 5.5); Primaries were even (3.7 to 3.3). The League's only win was on the Acropolis (seed 1040, 34 to 13). Battles were short, 4.7 Battle Rounds on average.

{{batch}}{{chart:batch-vp}}{{chart:batch-sources}}

Who scored

The Corporaider Squads (22 RP) carried the Directorate: 4.7 VP a squad, 21.4 per 100 RP, and 50 objective VP hinged on them. Hakon scored 4.7 a battle (7.2 per 100 RP) and the Runesmith 3.7 (24.3 per 100 RP). Odin's Einherjar scored 3.2 and were never destroyed. The Berserkir (30 RP) scored 0.7 a battle, and no objective VP ever hinged on them.

For the League, the Argyraspides (38 RP) scored 6.3 a battle and the Asklepian Medic (13 RP) 4.5, 34.6 per 100 RP, though it was destroyed in 4 of 6. Heron of Alexandria (55 RP) scored 1.1 a battle, 2.0 per 100 RP, and was destroyed in 3 of 6. The Hephaestian Tripod (20 RP) and the Heliostat Battery (30 RP) scored nothing at all in six battles.

{{chart:batch-unit-vp}}{{chart:batch-unit-vp-rp}}{{chart:batch-losses}}

Commands and abilities

  • Rune of Thor (Hakon): 11 uses, 35 damage, and PARALYZED on the target: the most effective ability of the matchup.
  • Hostile Takeover (Directorate, +1 loot a kill): 7 uses, 8 CP, recorded as buying nothing. The record does not see the loot it adds, so this is not measured.
  • Blinding Flash (Heliostat Battery, -1 to the target's HIT rolls): 8 uses, none recorded as changing an attack.
  • Name the Omen (League): 3 uses, 6 CP, recorded as buying nothing.
  • Double Time: 15 uses by the Directorate (12 bought nothing), 13 by the League (9 bought nothing).
{{chart:batch-unit-inaction}}

How sure

Five wins of six with a 2-to-1 gap in losses is a clear result for these lists. The League's two machines scoring nothing in six battles is the sharpest single finding; whether that is their cost or the AI's use of them needs a closer look.

closing: The Hephaestian Tripod and the Heliostat Battery (50 RP between them) scored nothing in six battles, and Blinding Flash changed nothing in 8 uses. The Berserkir scored 0.7 a battle for 30 RP. These are the units to look at first, for cost or for how the AI plays them.
